dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: What? You're looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello...?

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to be...

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Seem to be what, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Depressed? Well, then you're pretty close.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Ever since I lost my Vision, it feels like most of the things in this world don't mean anything to me anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Mm.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: It's you! It's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It has. How are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Me... Ah, I don't even know where to begin.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: I don't think I will ever recover my lost memories. But when I hold the sword my father gave me, I can still feel the traces of my past wishes...

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Can I truly walk the path of righteousness once again?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Have a safe journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As for your Vision?

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: It was confiscated due to the Vision Hunt Decree. It's nothing special really, it happened to others too.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: As for my opinion on the Vision Hunt Decree... Now? I don't have an opinion anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Then, some people reported that I had been slacking off at work due to my discontent with the Vision Hunt Decree... And you saw what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: I can't remember what my opinions were like before... And I don't really care about them anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been a while. How are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: Once the Vision Hunt Decree was abolished, my Vision was returned to me. Every time I hold the sword that my father gave me, I can feel the embers of my past wishes start to burn again...

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: It seems that I will walk this path of righteousness once more after all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It'll work out for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: If you put it like that, then... I'll try my best.

dialogues.speaker: Kurosawa Kyounosuke
dialogues.text: The things that my father has taught me, I haven't forgotten them. Let us encourage each other in our walk down the road of life.
